questions.context_sentence: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was an Austrian musician and composer.
questions.cn: 沃尔夫冈·阿马德乌斯·莫扎特是一位奥地利音乐家和作曲家。
questions.hint: com（共同）+ pos（放置）+ er（人）= 共同放置音符的人 → 作曲家
questions.prompt: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was an Austrian musician and ____.

questions.context_sentence: I work in a travel agency now.
questions.cn: 我现在在一家旅行社工作。
questions.hint: age（时代）+ ncy = 顺应时代的代理机构

questions.context_sentence: Before that I worked in a department store.
questions.cn: 在此之前我在一家百货商店工作。
questions.hint: department（部门）+ store（商店）= 各类部门齐全的百货商店

questions.context_sentence: They invited us to their party, but we decided not to go.
questions.cn: 他们邀请我们去他们的派对，但我们决定不去。
questions.hint: in（进入）+ vite（生命/活力）= 把人请进热烈的氛围 → 邀请
questions.prompt: They ____ us to their party, but we decided not to go. (提示: 邀请)

questions.context_sentence: They invited us to their party, but we decided not to go.
questions.cn: 他们邀请我们去他们的派对，但我们决定不去。
questions.hint: de（向下）+ cide（切断，来自词根 cide=cut）= 切断其他选项，做出决定
questions.prompt: They invited us to their party, but we ____ not to go. (提示: 决定)

questions.context_sentence: I was annoyed because they were late.
questions.cn: 我很生气，因为他们迟到了。
questions.hint: an（加强）+ noy（烦扰）+ ed = 感到被烦扰的 → 生气的

questions.context_sentence: Was the weather good when you were on holiday?
questions.cn: 你度假的时候天气好吗？
questions.hint: holy（神圣的）+ day（日子）= 神圣的节日/假期

questions.context_sentence: We couldn't afford to keep our car, so we sold it.
questions.cn: 我们买不起/养不起汽车了，所以把它卖了。
questions.hint: af + ford（向前走）= 有能力向前支撑 → 负担得起
questions.prompt: We couldn't ____ to keep our car, so we sold it. (提示: 负担得起)

questions.cn: 是的，我们在旧金山租了一辆车。
